allowedSourceMaterial.overview: After closing his agency Alibi.com and promising Flo that he would never lie to her again, Greg's new life became quiet, too quiet... Not for long! When he decides to propose to Flo, Greg is up against the wall and has to introduce his family. But with his crooked father and his ex-charm actress mother, this could ruin his future union. He has no choice but to reopen his agency with his former accomplices for an ultimate Alibi and to find more presentable fake parents.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can Greg stage the ultimate deception with substitute parents before his fiancée discovers his old habits never truly stopped?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Ready to propose to Flo, Greg faces a crisis: his eccentric parents could derail everything. To protect the wedding, he reopens his alibi agency with old accomplices to hire presentable stand-ins.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Light, comedic, and easy to follow, delivering steady, accessible farce across a breezy 88-minute runtime.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Philippe Lacheau, this French comedy leans into classic farce, escalating a pre-wedding dilemma into a swift, lighthearted scheme built on elaborate cover-ups.
